<!-- pr-reviewer: a439a2e5b024aac4889b1b5bc217c86c74a40cdb -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Note: #1138 is stacked on this PR and merges after it.

**What looks good**
- Diff against current upstream main is only this change: `lift.rs`, new `lift_coarse.rs` (coarsen moved out of `lift.rs` plus the new `cut`), `raster.rs` (`stands_over`), `rings.rs` (test-only `OPEN_INSET` hook, `cfg(test)`, zero in production), `lift_split.rs` doc line, `mod.rs`, tests, `rotary_adaptive.rs`, and `docs/decisions/982-microlift-acceptance.md`. No leftover #1007 content.
- Safety direction is right: a longer chord is kept only if it reads within the bound AND leaves no cell standing that the piece's own chords clear (`lift_coarse.rs` `cut`); otherwise the piece falls back to its fine chords. Anything the check cannot judge stays on the short chord; nothing new is emitted on long chords unchecked. `keeps()` removes the old tolerance.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; provenance lines present; decisions file present; no golden, snapshot, process-file, dependency or build.rs changes.

**Local results (merged with current upstream main, d595f0e)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| motion lib | 215 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| adaptive_band / adaptive_hsm / adaptive_orbit_seam | 2 / 1 (5 ignored, heavy) / 1 passed |
| pocket3d_hsm / rotary_adaptive | 3 (1 ignored) / 3 (3 ignored, heavy) passed |
| offset_shells / tiny_step / machining2d | 6 / 3 / 66 passed |
| app golden_cl / operations | 26 / 119 passed (6 ignored) |
| clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

Heavy-lane tests were not run (author reports them on the earlier head).

**Mutation check:** removing `&& !coarse.stands_over(ras)` from `lift_coarse.rs` `cut` turns `a_piece_takes_longer_chords_only_where_they_leave_no_sliver` (lift_tests.rs:162) and `the_slot_and_its_32_nm_twin_decide_the_same_way` (tests.rs:66) red; `the_lifted_plan_is_kept_only_at_or_under_the_spiral_reading` stays green, as it pins the `keeps` zero tolerance, not the sliver check. Reverted afterwards.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Platform numerics (#1010) and the STEP bore triple on Windows/macOS were not measured, as the body says.
- `rings.rs` carries a `cfg(test)` thread-local in production code; it compiles out, but worth knowing.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
